title: a new rule sentence with no register row: say how it is checked (a row in register.json), or mark it unchecked

explain.what: A rule file (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md or a source of the project's rule register) gained a sentence that no row of the register covers.
explain.why: A rule nobody checks drifts: it is read, then forgotten. A row names its check, or says out loud that nothing checks it (SPEC 4.5).
explain.fix: Add a row to <project folder>/rules/slop/register.json: the quoted sentence, its class (mechanical, proxy, voice, unchecked), its home and checks. A sentence that states no rule goes in the register's prose list.
